description: Returns a phased rollout plan (discovery, pilot, rollout, operations) with tasks, roles in RACI form, risks and indicators for the chosen implementation pattern. When readiness answers are given, preparation tasks for areas at level 0 or 1 are added to the discovery phase.

answers.description: Answers keyed by question id, each value an option id from get_readiness_questions

lang.description: Language of the result: sl, en, de or hr. Texts not yet translated are returned in English and marked in the result.
